## PhyloTreeProps.onNodeClick property

Called when a node marker is clicked (without dragging). When provided, clicking an internal node's marker calls this instead of toggling collapse, so the caller can offer a menu.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onNodeClick?: (node: TreeNodeInfo, event: React.MouseEvent) => void;
```
